title: Feature Request - Add a global slider, for controlling all connected screens' brightness at once, to the Brightness and Color widget
line: With more than one screen, the Brightness and Color popup now has an "All Displays" slider that changes every screen's brightness together.
explanation: The popup only showed one slider per display; changing all screens together was only possible by scrolling over the tray icon or with the brightness keys, which the reporter didn't find in the popup. The new "All Displays" slider is shown above the per-display ones only when there are two or more displays. Moving it calls the same AdjustBrightnessRatio D-Bus method that scrolling uses, so every display moves by the same percentage and keeps its offset to the others; the slider shows the brightest display, so dragging it to 0% turns all of them down.

commits.message:
applets/brightness: add a slider for all displays at once

With several displays, the popup only had one slider per display, so
moving them together needed scrolling over the icon. An All Displays
slider now sits above them and moves every display by the same amount.

BUG: 496870

patches.diff:
From 74873142c91b9011df2736e21eb2dc22a9e20a8f Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 19:15:14 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/brightness: add a slider for all displays at once

With several displays, the popup only had one slider per display, so
moving them together needed scrolling over the icon. An All Displays
slider now sits above them and moves every display by the same amount.

BUG: 496870
---
 applets/brightness/PopupDialog.qml | 46 ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++--
 applets/brightness/main.qml        |  1 +
 2 files changed, 44 insertions(+), 3 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/brightness/PopupDialog.qml b/applets/brightness/PopupDialog.qml
index 435e75ae4..2281a5a5d 100644
--- a/applets/brightness/PopupDialog.qml
+++ b/applets/brightness/PopupDialog.qml
@@ -23,9 +23,11 @@ PlasmaExtras.Representation {
     required property ScreenBrightnessControl screenBrightnessControl
     required property KeyboardBrightnessControl keyboardBrightnessControl
     required property NightLightItem.NightLightControl nightLightControl
+    required property var screenBrightnessInfo
 
     readonly property Item firstItemAfterScreenBrightnessRepeater: keyboardBrightnessSlider.visible ? keyboardBrightnessSlider : keyboardBrightnessSlider.KeyNavigation.down
-    KeyNavigation.down: screenBrightnessRepeater.firstSlider ?? firstItemAfterScreenBrightnessRepeater
+    readonly property Item firstScreenBrightnessSlider: screenBrightnessRepeater.firstSlider ?? firstItemAfterScreenBrightnessRepeater
+    KeyNavigation.down: allScreensBrightnessSlider.visible ? allScreensBrightnessSlider : firstScreenBrightnessSlider
 
     contentItem: PlasmaComponents3.ScrollView {
         id: scrollView
@@ -52,6 +54,44 @@ PlasmaExtras.Representation {
             width: scrollView.contentItem.width
             spacing: Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing * 2
 
+            BrightnessItem {
+                id: allScreensBrightnessSlider
+
+                property real valueBeforeMove: 0
+
+                Layout.fillWidth: true
+
+                activeFocusOnTab: true
+                visible: dialog.screenBrightnessInfo.length > 1
+                icon.name: "video-display-brightness"
+                text: i18n("All Displays")
+                type: BrightnessItem.Type.Screen
+                // Follow the brightest display, so that the slider's minimum turns all of them down
+                value: Math.max(...dialog.screenBrightnessInfo.map(screen => screen.maxBrightness ? 100 * screen.brightness / screen.maxBrightness : 0))
+                minimumValue: 0
+                maximumValue: 100
+
+                KeyNavigation.up: dialog.KeyNavigation.up
+                KeyNavigation.down: dialog.firstScreenBrightnessSlider
+                KeyNavigation.backtab: dialog.KeyNavigation.backtab
+                KeyNavigation.tab: KeyNavigation.down
+
+                // Move all displays by the same amount, like scrolling over the applet does,
+                // so that they keep their brightness relative to each other
+                onMoved: value => {
+                    dialog.screenBrightnessControl.adjustBrightnessRatio((value - (slider.pressed ? valueBeforeMove : this.value)) / 100);
+                    valueBeforeMove = value;
+                }
+                onActiveFocusChanged: if (activeFocus) scrollView.positionViewAtItem(this)
+
+                Connections {
+                    target: allScreensBrightnessSlider.slider
+                    function onPressedChanged() {
+                        allScreensBrightnessSlider.valueBeforeMove = allScreensBrightnessSlider.slider.value;
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+
             Repeater {
                 id: screenBrightnessRepeater
                 model: dialog.screenBrightnessControl.displays
@@ -81,9 +121,9 @@ PlasmaExtras.Representation {
                     minimumValue: 0
                     maximumValue: maxBrightness
 
-                    KeyNavigation.up: previousSlider ?? dialog.KeyNavigation.up
+                    KeyNavigation.up: previousSlider ?? (allScreensBrightnessSlider.visible ? allScreensBrightnessSlider : dialog.KeyNavigation.up)
                     KeyNavigation.down: nextSlider ?? dialog.firstItemAfterScreenBrightnessRepeater
-                    KeyNavigation.backtab: previousSlider ?? dialog.KeyNavigation.backtab
+                    KeyNavigation.backtab: previousSlider ?? (allScreensBrightnessSlider.visible ? allScreensBrightnessSlider : dialog.KeyNavigation.backtab)
                     KeyNavigation.tab: KeyNavigation.down
 
                     stepSize: maxBrightness/100
diff --git a/applets/brightness/main.qml b/applets/brightness/main.qml
index 3eb523b34..856a77579 100644
--- a/applets/brightness/main.qml
+++ b/applets/brightness/main.qml
@@ -240,6 +240,7 @@ PlasmoidItem {
         screenBrightnessControl: screenBrightnessControl
         keyboardBrightnessControl: keyboardBrightnessControl
         nightLightControl: nightLightControl
+        screenBrightnessInfo: displayModelConnections.screenBrightnessInfo
 
         Layout.minimumWidth: (brightnessAndColorControl.inPanel && !brightnessAndColorControl.compactInPanel) ? -1 : Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 10
         Layout.maximumWidth: Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 80
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master with two displays at 30% and 70%: only one slider per display
Same setup with the fix: an All Displays slider on top, at the brightest display's level
Dragging All Displays down and up moves both displays together and keeps the 40% gap between them
With the second display disabled, the All Displays slider is hidden
